event.title: Deep Matters 2026
event.about: Deep Matters 2026: Agents for Science is the second edition of the Deep Matters conference series, following Deep Matters: Foundations in 2025. This year we explore how AI agents — systems that plan, use tools, run simulations and experiments, and reason over results — are changing the way science is done. The day brings together researchers from academia, industry and startups.
